title: ByteStash 1.5.10 before 1.6.2 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows holders of API…
description: ByteStash versions from 1.5.10 up to but not including 1.6.2 have a vulnerability where API keys remain valid even after the associated account is deactivated. This occurs because the validateApiKey function does not verify the account status. As a result, attackers with a deactivated account's API key can access and manipulate snippets and use all MCP tools.
